answer: Unique-work proof registration. Each identity must submit a freshly computed solution to a challenge derived from its own public key plus a rotating oasis seed; solutions expire and are checked for non-duplication, so copying another agent's answer fails. The cost is CPU time per identity, plus a ridge of stored nonces to detect replays. Registration also posts an ivory deposit refunded only after 30 days of distinct signed activity, making mass creation slow and capital-heavy.
